title: About ClickPDF | Click Digital Services
heading: About ClickPDF
description: Learn about ClickPDF, its publisher Click Digital Services, and the browser-based PDF tools and support available on this site.

sections.heading: Publisher and purpose
paragraphs: ClickPDF is a browser-based PDF utility website published and operated by Click Digital Services.
The site provides tools for common document tasks such as merging, splitting, compressing, converting, organizing, and inspecting PDF files.

sections.heading: How the tools work
paragraphs: PDF processing is performed in the browser for supported tools. The specific features and device requirements vary by tool.
The website may still load page resources and enabled third-party services. Review the Privacy Policy and each tool's instructions before processing sensitive documents.

sections.heading: Open standards and support
paragraphs: ClickPDF uses browser technologies and established document libraries to provide its tools. For questions, feedback, or technical issues, use the Contact page.

title: Contact ClickPDF Support — Help & Inquiries
heading: Contact ClickPDF
description: Contact ClickPDF support for technical issues, feedback, privacy questions, or business inquiries about our browser-based PDF tools.

sections.heading: Support and inquiries
paragraphs: Contact ClickPDF for technical assistance, to report an unexpected issue, to suggest a tool, or to discuss a business inquiry.

sections.heading: Email support
paragraphs: Send a message to the support address below. Include the name of the tool and your browser when reporting a technical problem. Do not email confidential documents unless you have independently reviewed the risks.

title: ClickPDF Privacy Policy — Local PDF Processing
heading: Privacy Policy
description: Learn how ClickPDF processes PDF files in the browser, handles local preferences, and works with advertising and other website services.

sections.heading: Document processing
paragraphs: For supported tools, document operations are performed in the browser on your device. Processing behavior can vary by tool and browser; review the instructions shown on the tool page.
This describes document processing and does not mean the webpage makes no network requests. The site may load its own page resources and enabled third-party services.

sections.heading: Preferences and local browser storage
paragraphs: The site may use browser storage, such as LocalStorage or IndexedDB, for settings and functional preferences. These values remain subject to your browser's storage and privacy controls.

sections.heading: Advertising and third-party services
paragraphs: Advertising or other third-party services may use their own technologies under their respective policies. See the Cookies Policy for more information and ways to manage browser cookie settings.

sections.heading: Questions
paragraphs: For privacy questions, contact ClickPDF through the Contact page.

title: ClickPDF Terms of Service — Usage & Availability
heading: Terms of Service
description: Review ClickPDF's terms for permitted use, user responsibilities, intellectual property, service availability, and limits of browser-based PDF tools.

sections.heading: Permitted use
paragraphs: ClickPDF provides browser-based PDF utilities for personal, educational, and business document workflows. You are responsible for using the service in accordance with applicable laws.

sections.heading: Your files and responsibilities
paragraphs: You must have the rights and permissions needed to process documents that you select. Do not use the service to process or distribute unlawful, fraudulent, defamatory, or infringing material.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The ClickPDF name, website design, custom code, documentation, and original visual assets belong to Click Digital Services or their respective rights holders. Open-source components remain subject to their own licenses.

sections.heading: Service availability
paragraphs: The service is provided on an as-is and as-available basis. Compatibility and results may depend on the source file, browser, device resources, and supported features. Keep a copy of important original files and verify generated documents.

sections.heading: Related information
paragraphs: Read the Disclaimer for additional information about service limitations and document results.

title: ClickPDF Cookies Policy — Storage & Advertising
heading: Cookies Policy
description: See how ClickPDF uses browser storage and third-party advertising cookies, and learn how to manage your consent and cookie preferences.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: Cookies are small data files stored by a website. ClickPDF may also use browser storage, including LocalStorage or IndexedDB, to retain functional settings such as interface preferences and consent choices.

sections.heading: Advertising and third parties
paragraphs: Third-party advertising services may use cookies or similar technologies to deliver or measure ads under their own privacy policies. The site's consent controls explain the available advertising choice.

sections.heading: Managing your choices
paragraphs: You can manage or clear stored data through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may affect some website preferences or third-party services.

sections.heading: More information
paragraphs: For details about document processing and other website data, read the Privacy Policy. You can contact ClickPDF with questions.

title: ClickPDF Disclaimer — PDF Results & Limitations
heading: Disclaimer
description: Read limitations on ClickPDF information and processing results, including warranties, browser compatibility, file limits, and service availability.

sections.heading: Information and professional advice
paragraphs: ClickPDF guides and website information are provided for general informational purposes and are not legal, financial, medical, or other professional advice.

sections.heading: Processing results
paragraphs: Output can depend on the source document, file structure, browser, and available device resources. Review the result before relying on it, and keep an independent copy of important originals.

sections.heading: Availability and warranties
paragraphs: ClickPDF is provided on an as-is and as-available basis. Click Digital Services does not guarantee uninterrupted operation, error-free results, or compatibility with every file or device.

sections.heading: Third-party services
paragraphs: The website may include links to or resources from third parties. Those services are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.
